MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
SUBJECT : Disposition of Surplus United States Government Vehicles Sold to the Japanese Government.
1. References
a. AG 400.703. (9 Deo 46)ESS/FT SCAPIN 1384 , 9 December 1946, subject: Surplus United States Government Property to be Purchased by the Imperial Japanese Government.
b. AG 400.703 (20 Aug 47)CTS-V SCAPIN 1763 , 20 August 1947, subject: Control of Surplus United States Government Vehicles Sold to the Japanese Government.
c. Letter to General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, through Japanese Government Central Liaison and Coordination Office, from Chief of Government Motor Transportation Bureau, Railway Board, Ministry of Transportation (Tetsu No. 27), 14 February 1949, subject: Re Disposition of US Surplus Vehicles.
2. Paragraph 5 of reference 1a above as amended by paragraph 2 of reference 1b above is hereby rescinded.
3. Direct communication within the scope of this memorandum is authorized between Civil Transportation Section, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and interested agencies of the Japanese Government.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
